name: AltSpam Assist
description: Converts random spamming into perfect alternate spam. Configurable strength, timing window, and visual feedback.

strength.name: Strength
strength.description: How aggressively to correct input toward perfect alternate spam (0 = passthrough, 1 = full correction)

window-ms.name: Timing Window (ms)
window-ms.description: Time window for detecting an input pair as an alternate. Wider = more forgiving.

show-indicator.name: Show Indicator
show-indicator.description: Show rhythm indicator overlay during gameplay

correct-sound.name: Correction Sound
correct-sound.description: Play a subtle click when input is corrected
